title: SwarmEvent
description: One telemetry event per LLM invocation. Mirrors the TypeScript `SwarmEvent` interface in @mnmal-ai/swarm-types (packages/types/src/telemetry.ts). When adding fields here, mirror them in that interface; when adding them there, mirror them here. tests/integration/telemetry-contract.test.ts asserts this contract against the runtime type at build time.

id.description: Stable identifier for this event. Conventionally `evt-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{NNNN}`.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

session_id.description: Session this event belongs to. Multiple events share a session_id within a single LLM invocation chain.

role.description: Which oversight role produced this event.

commit_sha.description: Git SHA of the swarm content at invocation time.

tag.description: Optional git tag of the swarm content.

swarm_files_loaded.description: Paths of the swarm content files the loader fed into the prompt.

context_tokens_used.description: Estimated tokens consumed by the assembled swarm context.

tokens.description: Tokens the invocation used: input (cache reads and writes included) and output. Swarm budgets in tokens only.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of the LLM invocation in milliseconds.

input_summary.description: Optional short summary of the prompt input. Useful in dashboards.

output_summary.description: Optional short summary of the model response. Useful in dashboards.

authorId.description: Stable identifier for the human author of the run (goal-7b). Taxonomy-only today; enforcement deferred.
